name: @red-cup-engineering/organizing-with-python-in-vs-code
description: Organizing with Python inside VS Code: the Python specialization of the generic VS Code agent cockpit (panels, command routes, MCP/LSP attachments, readiness checks) downstream of @emsenn/organizing-with-vscode-agents and @emsenn/organizing-with-python. Binds the cockpit to a 'python' provider: open-notebook / run-cell / restart-kernel / run-lab-gate commands and WSL-venv / jupyter-installed / jupytext-paired readiness observers over the lab/ submodule.

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
